class.name: BehaviorTreeRunner
class.brief_description: Runs behavior tree resources for one AI agent.
class.description: Assign a [BehaviorTreeTask] as [member root_task], configure the optional [member blackboard], then call [method tick] manually or enable [member auto_tick] to update every process frame. On success or failure the runner stops, emits [signal tree_finished], and caches the terminal status. Call [method reset] to run the tree again. Runners maintain independent execution cursors even when sharing the same task resources.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the behavior tree using nonnegative [param delta] time. Once completed, returns the cached result without invoking tasks again until reset.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears execution state and restarts the tree on the next tick. The blackboard is preserved.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns true after the root returns success or failure.

method.name: get_last_status
method.description: Returns the latest status or [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] before the first tick.

method.name: set_root_task
method.description: Replaces the root task and resets the execution state.

method.name: set_blackboard
method.description: Sets the shared blackboard dictionary for this agent.

method.name: is_auto_tick_enabled
method.description: Returns whether automatic ticking is enabled.

members.member: Agent-specific shared state available to task scripts.
Process the root task every frame while it is running.

signal.name: tree_finished
signal.description: Emitted once when the root reaches a terminal status.
